search.note: Accepts a natural-language query. Include the current year when searching for recent information. Returns sourced result blocks; always carry the source URLs into the lead record.

web_read.note: Accepts URL + prompt; large pages may be summarized, so for raw HTML, PDFs, or directory listings prefer the shell fallback. WebFetch fails on authenticated pages — fall back to public sources only.

linkedin.note: No login-gated LinkedIn access. Use public LinkedIn pages via web_read/shell, or the Agent Reach LinkedIn MCP when its session is verified. Never guess profile URLs.
